series: U.S. Gulf Coast Conventional Gasoline Regular Spot Price FOB (EER_EPMRU_PF4_RGC_DPG)
notes: Primary benchmark. US Gulf Coast is the main refined-product supply point for Central America and the Caribbean. Local file downloads/PET_PRI_SPT_S1_M.xls.

series: U.S. Gulf Coast Ultra-Low Sulfur No 2 Diesel Spot Price (EER_EPD2DXL0_PF4_RGC_DPG)
notes: Primary benchmark. Some countries import higher-sulfur diesel; ULSD is the only free USGC diesel spot series.

series: U.S. Gulf Coast Kerosene-Type Jet Fuel Spot Price FOB (EER_EPJK_PF4_RGC_DPG)
notes: No free USGC household kerosene series; jet fuel is the same distillation cut and is used as the kerosene benchmark. Energy content differs slightly (IPCC NCV 43.8 vs 44.1 GJ/t).

series: U.S. Gulf Coast Kerosene-Type Jet Fuel Spot Price FOB (EER_EPJK_PF4_RGC_DPG)
Mont Belvieu TX Propane Spot Price FOB (EER_EPLLPA_PF4_Y44MB_DPG)
notes: Primary benchmark. Regional LPG is a propane-butane mix; no free Mont Belvieu butane series in this file.

series: PROXY: Brent x 0.814, where 0.814 is the ratio (USD/GJ) of the ARESEP 2024 Precio FOB estimado for bunker (12 monthly resolutions, mean 69.25 USD/bbl) to 2024 EIA Brent
publisher: ARESEP (Costa Rica) for the ratio; EIA for Brent
URL: https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/xls/PET_PRI_SPT_S1_M.xls (Brent); ARESEP resolutions RE-0002-IE-2024 to RE-0083-IE-2024 at https://www.recope.go.cr/wp-content/uploads/ (ratio)
notes: No free USGC No. 6 / HSFO spot series (Platts and Argus paywalled). Alternative upper proxy: EIA U.S. Residual Fuel Oil Wholesale/Resale Price by Refiners (EMA_EPPR_PWG_NUS_DPG, https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/xls/PET_PRI_REFOTH_A_EPPR_PWG_DPGAL_M.xls, ends 2022-03), ratio to Brent 0.946 (2018-2021). Check: DR MEM bulletins quote Platts fuel oil No. 6 FOB at 11.27 USD/MMBtu for 5 months of 2024.

series: Henry Hub Natural Gas Spot Price (RNGWHHD)
notes: Primary driver for US-sourced LNG. Same series in World Bank Pink Sheet (Natural gas US). Observed FOB price of US LNG exports to the Dominican Republic and Jamaica (EIA NG_MOVE_EXPC_S1_M.xls) is used to split the adder into liquefaction spread and shipping plus regasification.

fuel: Natural gas (as LNG) FOB to destination
series: Price of Liquefied U.S. Natural Gas Exports by Vessel to Dominican Republic / to Jamaica
notes: Observed FOB at US export terminal by destination; converted with 1.037 MMBtu/Mcf (EIA FAQ id=45).

series: Coal South African (fob Richards Bay NAR 6000 kcal/kg)
publisher: World Bank Commodity Price Data (Pink Sheet)
notes: Atlantic-basin thermal coal with a stated net calorific basis. The Colombian series (closest origin) is no longer in the Pink Sheet monthly file. Pink Sheet notes say Jan-May 2024 South African values are estimates. Australian Newcastle shown as alternative.

series: PROXY: Average cost of petroleum coke delivered for electricity generation all sectors (EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 4.1 continued)
notes: No free international petcoke benchmark. US delivered cost is mostly Gulf Coast refinery coke. Ratio to World Bank South African coal (USD/GJ) 2018-2025 mean 0.638 used for projection.
Primary benchmark and the oil driver in AEO2025 projections. Same values as World Bank Pink Sheet Brent.

series: PROXY: Gulf Coast (PADD 3) Aviation Gasoline Wholesale/Resale Price by Refiners (EMA_EPPV_PWG_R30_DPG) as a ratio to USGC gasoline
notes: No free avgas spot series after March 2022. Proxy: avgas = USGC gasoline x ratio 2018-2021 mean (1.579 in USD/GJ). Wholesale/resale price sits above a cargo price so the ratio is an upper estimate.
